items.title: 18.8 Stability of Complexes and Stability Constant (Kstab) (complexes ki stability aur stability constant) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 18.8 with Table 18.5 and Quick Check 18.6, printed pages 27-28.

blocks.text: Stability constant (Kstab) complex ion banne ke reaction ka equilibrium constant (Kc) hai. Paani ke solution mein pehla ligand paani hi hota hai; naya ligand dalne par woh metal ion se judne ke liye paani se compete (muqabla) karta hai. Misal ke tor par yeh equilibrium (complex banne ka reaction) aur us ka Kstab expression dekhein:

Paani [H₂O] solvent hai aur us ki concentration taqreeban constant (qaim) rehti hai, is liye Kstab expression mein nahi likhi jati. Stability constants aam tor par log₁₀ scale par diye jate hain, jis se bohat bare numbers ka muqabla aasan hota hai. log₁₀ Kstab jitna zyada, complex utna stable aur equilibrium utna daen taraf; jitna kam, complex utna kam stable aur us ke ligands utni aasani se hat jate hain. Kuch copper(II) complexes ke log₁₀ Kstab Table 18.5 mein hain.

blocks.caption: Table 18.5 Kuch Cu(II) complexes ke stability constants

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Table 18.5 mein ammonia complex ko [Cu(NH₃)₆]²⁻ likhti hai. log₁₀ Kstab = 13.1 wala copper(II) ammonia complex [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺ hai (aksar [Cu(NH₃)₄]²⁺), jo positive ion hai, jaisa topic 18.7.1 mein hai.
Data batata hai ke polydentate ligands wale complexes ke stability constants monodentate ligands wale complexes se zyada hote hain. Ise ligands ka chelating effect kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki equation mein complex ions ke charges nahi likhe: [Cu(H₂O)₆(aq)] + 3en → [Cu(en)₃] + 6H₂O. en neutral ligand hai, is liye complex par copper(II) ka 2+ charge rehta hai: [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ + 3en → [Cu(en)₃]²⁺ + 6H₂O.
Zyada Kstab wala ligand kam Kstab wale ligand ko hata sakta hai. Maslan chloride complex mein ammonia dalne se solution neela ho jata hai, kyun ke ammonia complex kaheen zyada stable hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yeh equation [CuCl₄]²⁻ + 6NH₃ → [Cu(NH₃)₆]²⁺ + 4Cl⁻ likhti hai. Copper(II) ke saath ammonia chaar ligands ki jagah leta hai aur [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺ banta hai, is liye sahi equation upar di gayi hai.
Isi tarah agar stable complex ko bohat zyada paani se patla (dilute) kiya jaye to equilibrium wapas baen taraf ja sakta hai aur asal hydrated ion dobara ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt: a) [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ aur NH₃ se [Cu(NH₃)₄]²⁺ banne ka Kstab expression likhein.
blocks.explanation: [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ + 4NH₃ ⇌ [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺ + 4H₂O ke liye: Kstab = [[Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺] / ([[Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺][NH₃]⁴); paani shamil nahi.

blocks.prompt: b) [CuCl₄]²⁻ (5.6) aur [Cu(EDTA)]²⁻ (18.8) ke log₁₀ Kstab se samjhayein ke polydentate ligands zyada stable complexes kyun banate hain.
blocks.explanation: EDTA complex taqreeban 10¹³ guna zyada stable hai. Ek EDTA ion chhe donor atoms se metal ko rings (halqon) mein pakarta hai aur chhe paani ke molecules ki jagah leta hai, is liye free (azad) particles ka number barhta hai (entropy barhti hai) aur complex bohat stable hota hai; yahi chelate effect hai.

blocks.prompt: c) [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ mein paani ki jagah ammonia ke step by step (qadam ba qadam) aane ke pehle step ka equation likhein.

items: Kstab = complex banne ka equilibrium constant; paani expression mein nahi.
Zyada log₁₀ Kstab = zyada stable; chelate effect: EDTA (18.8) aur en complexes bohat stable.
Zyada Kstab wala ligand kam wale ko hatata hai; bohat zyada paani reaction ulta kar sakta hai.
